L1.why: It was cancelled or a restart ended it; nothing is broken.

variants.how: Nothing to do unless you wanted that run; ask the agent to run it again.

variants.short: {agent_name} was blocked from reaching a private address
variants.L0: {agent_name} was blocked from reaching a private address

L1.why: The egress guard stops agents calling private network addresses. Either the agent tried something it should not, or a legitimate internal target needs allowlisting.

variants.how: Ask DAEDALUS to look at what it was trying to reach.

measures.label: Ask DAEDALUS to look at it
measures.say: Ask DAEDALUS to look at why {agent_name} failed.

L1.why: The run stopped before it finished, so whatever it was doing did not happen.

variants.how: Ask DAEDALUS to look at it, or run it again.

measures.label: Ask DAEDALUS to look at it
measures.say: Ask DAEDALUS to look at why {agent_name} failed.
